description: Retrieve confirmed customer domains currently using a specified vendor from STRAELO's persisted CSI coverage. Returns only confirmed `PRESENT` customer-vendor relationships with supporting evidence and confirmation timestamps, normalized and deduplicated. Results represent STRAELO's currently confirmed coverage, not the vendor's complete global customer base; an empty result means no confirmed customers are available within STRAELO coverage for that vendor, not that the vendor has no customers. **USE WHEN:** an agent needs to identify which customers are currently confirmed as using a specific vendor. **DO NOT USE WHEN:** scanning a specific customer domain for detectable vendors (`customer_vendor_detection`), retrieving historical adoption/removal events (`vendor_customer_adoption_change_lookup`), or identifying customer transition signals (`vendor_customer_transition_signal_lookup`).

limit.description: Maximum confirmed customers to return (1-100; default 100). No pagination; limits customers and returned_count, not confirmed_customer_count.
limit.title: Limit

vendor.description: Technology/vendor to query; canonical names are accepted, with judge.me normalized to judgeme.
vendor.title: Vendor

name: vendor_customer_confirmed_lookup

confirmed_customer_count.description: Total confirmed PRESENT customers for the vendor.

customers.description: Confirmed customer relationships, ordered by confirmation freshness.

customer_domain.description: Confirmed customer domain using the technology/vendor.

items.description: Fingerprint identifiers that matched during confirmation.

last_confirmed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the PRESENT relationship was last confirmed.

response_validity.description: Response validity of the confirming observation.

scanner_version.description: Scanner version that produced the confirmation.

returned_count.description: Number of customers returned in this response (bounded by limit).

title: Vendor Customer Confirmed Lookup
